messages:
anita: CI red on main -> lots of tests failing in integration suite, looks like a single downstream mock failing.
jay: which mock? link to job: https://ci.internal/runs/6882
anita: mock-metadata is returning 502/connection reset across several tests. quick log snippet:
```
ERROR: fetch metadata for user 123 -> 502 Service Unavailable
cause: net/http: connection reset by peer
```
ci-bot: build 6882 failed: 14 tests failed, rerun recommended (/rerun 6882)
maria: rerunning now
samir: if it's a mock process crash we should check k8s events on the test cluster, last week we had OOM spikes on the mock cluster after the new schema load
anita: good call, samir — can you grep events? ops-bot: fetched events for pod mock-metadata-5b7c:
```
Warning  OOMKilled  2m  kubelet  Container memory usage exceeded limit
```
samir: yep OOMKilled around the same time the tests hit heavy parallel queries. looks like the mock's memory growth regress from the new serialization patch.
jay: ok, two options: 1) pin mock image to previous tag in CI chart (quick workaround), 2) increase replica + mem limit in CI to buy time. any preference?
maria: pin image for PR CI + open a follow-up to fix leak in mock service
anita: who can open the follow-up? assign to eng-infra or eng-ml?
samir: eng-ml owns the mock code, i'll open the ticket and add a bisect request.
ci-bot: rerun 6882 started (job 6883)
maria: rerun passed for the previously failing tests ✅
jay: great. samir can you include repro steps (local docker-compose load + stress script) in the ticket so we can reproduce memory growth
samir: yes will add steps and a heap dump collection script. also adding a temporary CI gate: if mock OOM in last 24h, block merges to main.
anita: thanks. note for release notes: transient CI OOM on mock-metadata -> pinned image + follow-up leak fix tracked in M-3421
maria: leaving a comment on the PR to explain flake and that it's safe to merge after rerun
anita: closing thread, ping me if it recurs :thumbsup:
